# telnyx_telephony_credential_token (Ephemeral Resource)

An access token for a telephony credential, which a WebRTC client signs in with. It is never stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A JWT for a WebRTC client. It is minted on every run and never stored.
ephemeral "telnyx_telephony_credential_token" "web" {
  id = telnyx_telephony_credential.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The object's id.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) The JSON Web Token a WebRTC client signs in with.
